jobs.title: Shipping and Receiving Associate
jobs.description:
We have great opportunity for those seeking a new challenge, but also a fantastic place to work. Come grow with us!

SPS offers a competitive benefits package including paid time off, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, legal and life insurance, transit program, referral bonuses, pet discounts, EAP, and a 401K with company match.

Schedule: Typically Monday - Friday, 7:30AM-4:30PM/8AM-5PM (Flexes based on area assisting with)

What You Will Be Doing

  • Giving amazing customer service to our onsite operation by scanning/delivering/tracking/reporting in and outgoing business packages and mail (via UPS, USPS, Fedex, etc).
  • Assisting the onsite personnel in retrieving their packages and providing records management in person, by email, by phone, or similar methods.
  • Oversee the onsite business center, which may include: office supply stocking, assisting with copy/print orders, conference room setup up, pantry inventory, or light facilities.
  • Serves as backup to route driving roles, which provide delivery to onsite personnel for packages, pallets, etc.

What We Need From You

  • 3+ year experience in shipping & receiving, mailroom, route driving, or similar services.
  • Valid U.S. Driver's License, must be at least 25 years old to meet our standards to company car insurance, and have had license for at least 5 years.
  • A positive and professional attitude with a willingness to go above and beyond for our customers.
  • Previous material handling skills a plus, including ability to use motorized and manual equipment such as forklifts (in locations where they are needed), pallet jacks, and hand trucks.
  • Ability to perform the following types of physical activities: lift up to 50 pounds, push/pull to move equipment, bend/stoop/squat/kneel, and reach above shoulders
  • Background and experience working in a warehouse or loading dock environment, with exposure to varied weather conditions a plus.
  • Must be willing to be cross-trained to support all tasks required for that site, including, but not limited to: routes, receiving, mail services, shipping, floaters, freight coordination & logistics, loading dock operations, and customer service/help desk. Must be experienced with and able to troubleshoot issues regarding tracking software, secure lockers, and other tools & technology used by the SRM team. Must remain flexible and ready to support the needs of the business. In some field offices, Supervisors will collaborate with cross functional partners to support waste, secure waste, and eWaste programs.

Compensation

The expected compensation is an estimate, and the final offer will depend on skills, experience, location, and other job-related factors.

Vacancy Status

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Pay Range

$21 - $21 USD

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: An opportunity to enter a job that allows you to learn new skills or use a variety of them that may lead you to uncover other career opportunities.
  • Learning & Development: At SPS, we promote a work culture of learning so that you can develop to be the best at what you do.
  • We Recognize Talent: We offer a variety of recognition programs for all levels of employees.
  • Paid Time Off: Full time: Minimum of 80 hours/calendar year. Part time/temporary: Minimum of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked. PTO amounts may increase based on tenure and/or the assigned account. PTO allows employees to take approved time off for any reason.
  • Bonuses: Are available for employee and client referrals for current employees.
  • Benefit Offerings: Medical, Dental, Vision, HCFSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter Transit and Parking Pre-Tax Plans, Supplemental Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Program, Identify Theft Protection, Pet Discounts, Pet Insurance, Group Home and Auto Insurance, EAP, Short Term Disability, Life Insurance, Education Discounts, 401k w/ matching, and Entertainment Discounts.
    • Note: Please inquire with the Human Resources team for benefit offerings per role as regular positions that routinely are under 30 hours/week may have a different benefit offering.
About SPS

SPS is a global workplace solutions and business transformation company operating in more than 20 countries. Across North America, we help clients enhance workplace experiences and business operations through services including workplace support, physical and digital mailroom solutions, intelligent document processing, reception and concierge services, and other business support offerings.

Our clients include leading organizations across banking, insurance, legal, higher education, professional services, and many Fortune 500 companies.

jobs.title: Flexible Part-Time:Receiving Associate-Chicago
jobs.description:
Opportunity in Chicago

Fast Facts

  • Part-Time Opportunity in Chicago: Receiving Associate
  • Based in: Chicago, IL
  • Company: FedEx Supply Chain
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our FedEx Supply Chain team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Warehousing And Distribution industry.

What You Get

  • Pay Rate: $17-$22/Hour (approx. $20.5k/Year)
  • Benefits: Weekly pay options may be available.
  • Perfect for students or those seeking supplemental income.

Day-to-Day

  • This role focuses on your professional skills with a schedule that fits your life.

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

jobs.title: Chicago Full-time Overnight Warehouse Associate | Hiring
jobs.description:
Local Job Overview: Chicago

Job Title: Overnight Warehouse Associate (Gig/Contract) Hiring Organization: Amazon Based in: Chicago, IL (our growing Chicago office)

Compensation: $21-$25/Hour (approx. $48.4k/Year) Benefits: This role offers competitive pay. Set your own schedule.

Day-to-Day

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Logistics.

  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. Everything accomplished overnight determines the success of the delivery fleet the following morning. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company. Most importantly, you are financially rewarded for your hours with substantial "shift differentials" added directly to your base hourly wage.

Core Nightly Objectives

  1. High-Octane Order Processing: Your primary directive is to clear the digital backlog of orders placed during the evening. You will heavily engage in rapid picking and packing operations to ensure all parcels hit the loading dock before the critical dawn dispatch deadlines.
  2. Sortation and Palletizing: You will sort the completed, labeled packages by their final zip codes, meticulously stacking them onto pallets and wrapping them securely for the local delivery stations that dispatch at sunrise.
  3. Facility Reset and Staging: In the final hours of your shift, you will help reset the massive facility. This includes clearing cardboard debris, sweeping aisles, and fully restocking the packing stations with tape, boxes, and dunnage so the incoming day shift can hit the ground running.

Night Shift Rewards and Benefits

The financial perks of the night shift are undeniable, but they come paired with Amazon's legendary corporate benefits. You do not sacrifice quality of life for working nights. You receive the exact same Day 1 healthcare, dental, and vision insurance as daytime employees. You gain immediate access to our 401(k) matching program and the incredible Career Choice tuition coverage. If you are 18+, can lift up to 49 pounds, and thrive in the moonlight, apply today.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate - Hiring Immediately
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Target takes pride in its top-ranking position among retailers in the US. Its aim is to make daily life for families as enjoyable and stress-free as possible with its superior product and service offerings.

Roles and Duties:

  • Respect and observe all safety regulations and policies to foster a safe and secure working environment for everyone.
  • Acquire the necessary skills needed to work in a high-volume warehouse by attending safety training sessions.
  • Perform various activities such as packing, loading, and shipping goods to support the distribution of items to stores and customers.
  • Maintain the accuracy of product processing to ensure successful delivery to our stores and customers.
  • Keep safety, swiftness, and efficiency at the forefront of handling freight and moving inventory during warehouse activities.
  • A clean and tidy work area is an essential component of maintaining a professional and competent work image.
  • Being punctual at work and carrying out assigned tasks with precision and timeliness are essential for job performance.
  • To sustain continuous improvement, it's essential to monitor and measure progress over time. This can involve tracking key metrics related to process improvements and identifying areas for ongoing refinement
  • Sustains a genial and cooperative attitude when working on tasks alone or with fellow team members.

Requirements:

  • Possesses the strength and endurance to frequently lift and transport items ranging from 35-50 pounds during a work shift.
  • Can move and transport items weighing up to 60 pounds occasionally during their work shift.
  • Carry out work duties that demand regular standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching actions.
  • A positive and respectful approach is crucial to succeeding in both solo projects and team efforts.
  • Possessing a sound understanding of rudimentary mathematical skills, including counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Proficient in reading and understanding product information on labels, tickets, and documentation.
  • After undergoing training, one can competently use computer systems and handheld devices without much supervision.
  • A significant component of having strong communication skills is the ability to articulate effectively and accurately
  • The ability to comprehend and follow safety procedures, practices, and instructions necessitates adequate proficiency in reading, speaking, and comprehending the English language.

Additional Requirements:

  • Knowledgeable about the safe use of all powered equipment, such as Scissor Lift, Pallet Rider, Sit Down & Standup Forklift, and can work at heights of up to 40ft as required.
  • Engage in work activities that entail being stationed on a mezzanine level, reaching a height of up to 40 ft, wherever relevant
  • Capable of performing duties in temperature-controlled settings, including refrigeration and freezing units, throughout the workday.

Benefits:

Eligible Target team members have the option to enroll in a comprehensive benefits package, but must also adhere to the applicable eligibility requirements and other stipulations.

Note:

Your chances of getting the Warehouse Operations position will depend on your fitness for either the Warehousing Worker or Warehouse Associate positions, based on your performance in the questionnaire and assessment during the application process. Below are the prerequisites for both roles, with access to extensive information on job duties provided by accessing the links at the end of this page.

About UPS & Our Culture

When UPS says immediate hire, we mean it. During peak season, our package center teams expand by thousands of associates in a matter of weeks, and we have built our onboarding system to get people working — and getting paid — as fast as any warehouse employer in America. If you are searching for seasonal warehouse jobs hiring immediately with a brand name you trust, competitive hourly pay, and a genuine shot at a permanent career, our Peak Warehouse Sorter position is open and ready for you right now. No lengthy application process, no multi-week waiting period — UPS peak hiring is designed for speed because the packages do not wait for anyone.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I applied on a Monday and was working by Thursday. The onboarding process at UPS during peak is extremely fast and well-organized — they know how to bring large numbers of people in quickly without it feeling chaotic. The pay was better than I expected for a seasonal warehouse job hiring immediately, the overtime was genuinely available, and I was offered a permanent position before the season even ended." - Former Peak Sorter, Now Permanent Associate, Seattle, WA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Seasonal Peak Warehouse Sorter, you join our package center sort operation during the November-through-January holiday window, processing the highest package volumes of the year with speed and accuracy that keeps America's holiday delivery commitments intact.

  • Rapid Onboarding & Immediate Start: Complete UPS's streamlined peak-season onboarding process — safety orientation, method training, and first sort shift — within days of your offer letter, with your first paycheck arriving the following week without exception.
  • Peak Volume Sorting: Sort dramatically elevated holiday package volumes on high-speed conveyor systems, reading destination routing codes and diverting parcels accurately to outbound lanes at full production rate within your first few shifts on the job.
  • Overtime Priority Access: As a seasonal sorter during peak, you have first access to available overtime hours during the highest-volume weeks — Black Friday, Cyber Monday, pre-Christmas — generating a seasonal paycheck significantly larger than standard hours provide.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Seasonal Peak Warehouse Sorters receive competitive hourly pay, weekly direct-deposit paychecks, and significant overtime availability throughout the peak window. Associates who demonstrate performance and reliability during the seasonal period receive formal permanent hire consideration — converting a temporary position into a Teamsters union career complete with medical, dental, vision, pension, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition benefits.
